problem: Production /en/prijzen rendered the Dutch pricing H1 even though the canonical English pricing translation existed in the static cache.
root_cause: The offline localized-route builder returned null for the entire translation map when any translatable string anywhere on the public site was missing from cache. That converted a local cache miss into a site-wide static-English disablement.
prevention: Offline release builds must always preserve and apply cached translations that are available.
Missing translations are route/string-local runtime fallback, never a global switch back to Dutch.
STATIC_I18N_REQUIRE_CACHE=1 remains fail-closed for explicit cache-completeness verification.
